(שני בנים תאומים, שאחד מהם נקרא על שמו, נולדו אחרי מותו). בחורף תש"ח נטל חלק בהגנה על היישוב העברי בירושלים ונשלח להוציא את חברי תזמורת המשטרה מבית-הספר לשוטרים. כשעברה המכונית בשכונת שייח'-ג'ראח נפגע מכדור ונפל ביום ה' בשבט תש"ח 16.1.1948)). נקבר בהר-הזיתים. מצבה לזכרו הוקמה בבית-הקברות הצבאי בהר-הרצל בירושלים.שמו נחקק באנדרטה שהוקמה בבית העלמין הצבאי בהר-הרצל לזכר חללי הרובע היהודי ולזכר לוחמים שנפלו במערכה על ירושלים והובאו לקבורה בהר-הזיתים.
cvEn:
Haim Zadik, son of Miriam and Yosef, was born on the fourth of Kislev 5681 (15 November 1920) in the city of Izmir, Turkey. He completed elementary school and three grades of high school, and in 1935 he immigrated to Eretz Israel and settled in Jerusalem. There he completed his studies in Hebrew and English in evening classes. From the time of his arrival in the country until 1941 he served in the police. He married Esther, and they had a daughter. (Twin sons, one of whom was named after him, were born after his death.)

In the winter of 5708 (1948), he took part in the defense of the Jewish community in Jerusalem and was sent to bring the members of the police orchestra out of the police training school. As the car was passing through the Sheikh Jarrah neighborhood, he was hit by a bullet and fell on the fifth of Shevat 5708 (16 January 1948). He was buried on the Mount of Olives. A memorial headstone in his honor was erected in the military cemetery on Mount Herzl in Jerusalem.

His name is inscribed on the memorial erected in the military cemetery on Mount Herzl in memory of the fallen of the Jewish Quarter, and in memory of the fighters who fell in the battle for Jerusalem and were buried on the Mount of Olives.
